blocks.text: Electronic configurations dikhane ka ek mufeed tareeqa woh diagram hai jo electrons ko khanon (boxes) mein rakhta hai. Har khana ek atomic orbital hai; khane neeche se oopar barhti energy ki tarteeb mein hain; electron ek teer hai jis ka rukh us ka spin dikhata hai; aur jab do electrons ek orbital mein hon to un ke spin ulte hain, to khane ke do teer ulti simton mein hain. Khala ke ek hi ilaqe ke electrons ek doosre ko dhakelte (repel) hain kyunke un ka charge ek jaisa hai, is liye jahan mumkin ho electrons is dhakel ko kam karne ke liye ek subshell ke alag alag orbitals mein rehte hain, mukhtalif orbitals mein ek jaise spins ke saath; woh sirf tab jora banate hain jab subshell mein koi khali orbital na bache. Carbon, nitrogen aur oxygen ki electronic banawat yeh dikhati hai: carbon ke do 2p electrons aur nitrogen ke teen alag alag orbitals mein hain, aur sirf oxygen mein chautha electron jora banane par majboor hai.

blocks.alt: Boxes mein boron, neeche se oopar: 1s mein ulte teeron ka joRa, 2s mein ulte teeron ka joRa, aur 2p ke teen khane jin mein pehle mein ek oopar wala teer aur baqi do khaali.

blocks.alt: Carbon (1s2 2s2 2p2), nitrogen (1s2 2s2 2p3) aur oxygen (1s2 2s2 2p4) ke box diagrams. Carbon ke teen 2p boxes mein se do mein aik aik teer, nitrogen ke teeno mein aik aik, aur oxygen ke 2px mein joray aur 2py aur 2pz mein aik aik: electrons tab hi joray bante hain jab har orbital mein pehle se aik ho.

blocks.text: [Ar] argon core 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 ke liye hai, jise chhapi hui table potassium se krypton tak har unsur ke liye poora likhti hai. Chromium (3d5 4s1) aur copper (3d10 4s1) jaise dikhaye gaye waise hi chhape hain: aadha bhara ya poora bhara d subshell tarjeeh pata hai.

blocks.prompt: Phosphorus (Z = 15) ke valence electrons ka box diagram alfaz mein likhein, Hund ke rule aur Pauli ke principle par chalte hue.
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p3 hai. Us ke valence electrons 3s ka jora hain, ek khana oopar aur neeche ke teer ke saath, aur teen 3p electrons, teen khanon px, py aur pz mein ek ek oopar ka teer, ghair-jura mutawazi spins ke saath.

items: Box diagrams: har orbital ka ek khana, energy se oopar ki taraf tarteeb, spins ke liye teer, jora hone par ulte teer; electrons jora banane se pehle subshell ke orbitals par phailte hain (C do akele, N teen akele, O ek jora).
Table 2.7 Z = 1 se 36 ki ground state configurations deti hai; 4s 3d se pehle bharta hai, aur Cr aur Cu 3d5 4s1 aur 3d10 4s1 lete hain.
